parameters.jsCode: const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const f=$json.path||$json.filePath||$json.filename;const b=path.basename(f||'');const m=b.match(/(TDR-\d+)/i);const d=new Date();const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const id=(m?m[1].toUpperCase():`TDR-${d.getFullYear()}${p(d.getMonth()+1)}${p(d.getDate())}-${p(d.getHours())}${p(d.getMinutes())}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase()}`);const root=($env.TENDERS_ROOT||'\\JDRIVE\Tenders')+'/'+id;['01_Source_Docs','02_Parsed_Text','03_Doc_Index','04_Go_NoGo_Pack','05_RFI','06_Scope_Extract','07_Pricing_Pack','99_Admin'].forEach(x=>fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root,x),{recursive:true}));return [{json:{tender_id:id,tender_root:root,intake_file:f,repo_root:process.cwd(),run_log:[]}}];

parameters.command: if [[ "{{$json.intake_file}}" == *.zip ]]; then unzip -o "{{$json.intake_file}}" -d "{{$json.tender_root}}/01_Source_Docs"; else cp "{{$json.intake_file}}" "{{$json.tender_root}}/01_Source_Docs/"; fi && cp "{{$env.TEMPLATE_TENDER_CONTROL}}" "{{$json.tender_root}}/07_Pricing_Pack/Tender_Control.xlsx" && cp "{{$env.TEMPLATE_RFI}}" "{{$json.tender_root}}/05_RFI/RFI_Draft.xlsx"

parameters.jsonBody: ={{(()=>{const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const dir=p.join($json.tender_root,'02_Parsed_Text');const docs=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.txt')&&!x.includes('_p')).map(x=>({file:x,text:fs.readFileSync(p.join(dir,x),'utf-8').slice(0,6000)}));return {model:$env.OPENAI_MODEL_MAIN||'gpt-4.1',store:false,temperature:0.1,max_output_tokens:2600,input:[{role:'system',content:'Build doc_index with evidence anchors only.'},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({tender_id:$json.tender_id,docs})}],text:{format:{type:'json_schema',name:'doc_index',strict:true,schema:{type:'object',properties:{tender_id:{type:'string'},documents:{type:'array'},high_confidence:{type:'boolean'},unknowns:{type:'array'}},required:['tender_id','documents','high_confidence','unknowns'],additionalProperties:false}}}}})()}}

parameters.jsCode: const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const req=JSON.parse($json.output_text||$json.output?.[0]?.content?.[0]?.text||'{}');fs.writeFileSync(p.join($json.tender_root,'04_Go_NoGo_Pack','requirements_extract.json'),JSON.stringify(req,null,2));const md=['# Go/No-Go Pack',`Tender_ID: ${$json.tender_id}`,'','## 3-line scope',req.scope_summary_3_lines||'UNKNOWN','','## Design maturity',req.design_maturity||'Unknown','','## Risks',JSON.stringify(req.contract_risks||[],null,2),'','## Tier',String(req.recommended_risk_tier||'UNKNOWN'),'','## Recommendation',req.recommended_go||'Go_with_Conditions','','## Conditions',JSON.stringify(req.go_conditions||[],null,2),'','RFI count: '+((req.missing_information||[]).length),'Next action after Go: send RFIs immediately'].join('\n');fs.writeFileSync(p.join($json.tender_root,'04_Go_NoGo_Pack','go_nogo_pack.md'),md);const ts=new Date().toISOString();$json.run_log.push({state:'GO_NO_GO_PACK',started:ts,ended:ts,status:'OK',error:''});fs.writeFileSync(p.join($json.tender_root,'99_Admin','run_log.json'),JSON.stringify($json.run_log,null,2));return [{json:{...$json,requirements_extract:req}}];
